Termo · IA · Dinámica

Simulador de ciclos termodinámicos por volúmenes de control del proyecto Termo·IA·Dinámica, inspirado en el laboratorio virtual CyclePad (Forbus et al., 1999).

Referencias
  1. Forbus, K. D., Whalley, P. B., Everett, J. O., Ureel, L., Brokowski, M., Baher, J. y Kuehne, S. E. (1999). CyclePad: An articulate virtual laboratory for engineering thermodynamics. Artificial Intelligence, 114, 297–347. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0004-3702(99)00080-6 · PDF
  2. Franz Inc. (s. f.). CyclePad: An articulate virtual laboratory for thermodynamic cycles. https://franz.com/success/customer_apps/artificial_intelligence/cyclepad.lhtml
  3. Tuttle, K. L. y Wu, C. (2001). Intelligent computer assisted instruction in thermodynamics at the U.S. Naval Academy. Qualitative Reasoning Workshop (QR’01). https://www.qrg.northwestern.edu/papers/Files/qr-workshops/QR01/paper12.doc
